# Agent Studio Team Setup Skill

## Purpose
Guides the `team-setup` AI agent (or human developer) through safe, deterministic multi-IDE onboarding.

## Golden Rules
1. **Canonical Source:** Edit ONLY `.agent-team/team.yaml`, `.agent-team/model-index.json`, `.agent-team/agents/*.md`, and `.agent-team/skills/*/SKILL.md`.
2. **Never Hand-Edit Compiled Outputs:** Always run `agent-studio sync` to regenerate IDE adapters cleanly.
3. **Preserve Existing Work:** `init` never clobbers an existing `pipeline/board.json`, and `sync` uses managed Markdown blocks and key-scoped JSON merges.
4. **Verify Health:** Finish every setup or config change with `agent-studio doctor` and `agent-studio sync --check`.

## Deep Architectural Research & `code-reviewer` Tailoring
1. **Survey Architecture:** Inspect entry points, module boundaries, state stores, concurrency/locking primitives, and trust boundaries (delegate 5+ file surveys to a read-only `research` subagent).
2. **Classify & Extract Invariants:** Identify topology (modular monolith, monorepo, microservices, layered, event-driven, full-stack), lockstep/coupling rules, forbidden cross-layer imports, and known failure modes.
3. **Equip `code-reviewer`:** Populate `.agent-team/skills/architecture-review/SKILL.md` (clearing the `PENDING DEEP RESEARCH` / `<!-- architecture-research: pending -->` marker) and customize `.agent-team/agents/code-reviewer.md` with repo-specific review checks before running `agent-studio sync`.
4. **Brownfield Upgrades:** When upgrading an existing repo without `--force`, add `code-reviewer` to `team.yaml` (`roster` + `orchestrator.handoffs`) and `model-index.json`, ensure `skills/code-review` and `skills/architecture-review` exist, and run `agent-studio sync`.

## Quick Commands
> **CLI Fallback:** If `agent-studio` is not yet on `PATH`, the VS Code/Antigravity extension auto-shims it into `~/.agent-studio/bin` (or run `node ~/.agent-studio/bin/studio-cli.mjs ...`).
- Global bootstrap (`team-setup` in all IDEs): `agent-studio init --global`
- Project bootstrap: `agent-studio init --ides antigravity,claude-code,copilot-vscode --non-interactive`
- Safely upgrade stock templates & configs: `agent-studio upgrade`
- Inspect/update model routing: `agent-studio models show` / `agent-studio models set-policy prefer-fallback --sync`
- Recompile after `.agent-team/` edits: `agent-studio sync`
- CI / QA drift check: `agent-studio sync --check`
- Diagnostics: `agent-studio doctor`
- Launch Web Studio: `agent-studio serve --open`
